name: anagnosis
description: Anagnosis models the continuity and legitimacy of political succession across world history. Unlike 4X games that allow arbitrary 'evolution' (e.g. Tang Dynasty to Ottoman Empire), it types each succession by what the successor inherits from its predecessor — ruling people (software) and territory (hardware) — across ethnicity, territory, ideology, and time.
